about.title: About us
about.description_1: At Cange, we created a process and task management platform that puts the power in our customers' hands. With it, anyone can create, customize and automate workflows – from scratch and in just a few minutes.
about.description_2: Our no-code technology was developed to adapt to companies of all sizes and segments, allowing teams to execute and track each step with clarity, generating real-time data for faster decisions and more efficient strategies.
about.description_3: More than a tool, Cange is an invitation to transform the way your company operates, with autonomy, agility and intelligence.
about.mission_desc: Through technology, we create solutions that transform the way companies operate, providing autonomy, agility and intelligence.
about.vision_desc: To be a national reference as a process and task management platform, achieving business sustainability and international presence.
about.history_desc: A summary of our journey and how we got here.
about.values_title: Culture grounded in People, Processes and Technology
about.value_1_desc: We constantly seek creative and effective solutions, simplifying complex processes to offer an intuitive and easy-to-use experience that meets market needs and expectations in an innovative and accessible way.
about.value_2_desc: We put people at the center of everything we do, prioritizing empathy, transparency and respect to build genuine and meaningful connections with our employees, clients and partners.
about.value_3_desc: We take full responsibility for everything, acting as if each project or task were our own business, ensuring commitment and excellence in every detail.
about.value_4_desc: What is right is right, what is wrong is wrong, and what is fair is fair.
about.value_5_desc: We constantly seek to exceed expectations, always reaching challenging goals.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.welcome: Welcome to Cange. Cange is a process and task management tool, which gives its customers autonomy to create and customize their business flows. From demand creation to the generation of insights, developed to adapt to any company and have its processes built from scratch in few minutes.
terms.objective: The purpose of the Cange's Terms of Use is to clearly explain how logic works and the rules that must be followed for use. New features are launched regularly to improve the user experience, which may require updates to the Terms of Use. If there are changes, we will notify users and ask them to agree again. Unfortunately, if you do not agree with the Privacy and Data Protection Policy, you will not be able to continue using Cange. However, it is possible to revoke consent at any time, which will require account termination.
terms.privacy_protection: Protection of your Privacy and Personal Data
terms.privacy_desc: Cange has Privacy and Personal Data Protection Policies which are explained in detail here. These policies describe how we treat your personal information and protect your privacy when using our services. To use our platform and associated services, you must agree to our policies. Cange will use the information provided within the limits established in our Privacy and Data Protection Policy.
terms.login_desc: To use Cange's management services, you must register and log in to the platform. The data provided during registration or collected automatically will be subject to Cange's privacy and personal data protection policies. The user may update his data at any time in the settings panel and must guarantee that the information provided is true and accurate. If the information is false, the user may be held responsible in accordance with local legislation.
terms.functional_desc_1: Cange has the possibility of adding or removing features and tools as improvements, changes and/or natural updates to the service. The goal is to offer a better service to as many users as possible. In extreme cases, services may be suspended or interrupted, but we will always provide 30 days' notice before terminating them completely.
terms.functional_desc_2: Features offered for free by Cange are not guaranteed to be maintained indefinitely. They can be discontinued at any time or even included in one of the paid plans, which will require contracting to continue using the services.
terms.functional_desc_3: Cange may add new limitations or discontinue some features at any time, whether for technological reasons or business strategies. The goal is always to improve current features and add new ones that bring more value to companies and users. If it is necessary to interrupt a feature, we will do our best to replace it with others that generate equal or greater value for the majority of users.
terms.subscription_desc: When purchasing a Cange service, you can choose between a free plan or one of the paid plans available at the time of purchase. If you choose a paid plan, you will be automatically charged for the renewal at the end of the billing cycle, considering the value of the service with any additions purchased during the term. Your company can purchase new user licenses or services at any time. Cange may practice different pricing and feature policies for different organization profiles, area of activity, location or in specific promotions. If a trial period of a paid plan is offered, your company will have access to the tools offered, and if you decide not to hire the plan, the tools will once again be limited to the free plan. To have access to the paid plans, you must sign up in our plan store or directly with our sales team, and billing will be made periodically until cancellation. Cange reserves the right to change prices and to discontinue or add features according to business strategies and technological issues.
terms.cancellation_desc_1: Users with an administrator profile have the option to cancel purchased plans at any time through the contact area on the Cange website. After cancellation is requested, the company will still be able to use the tool with the same features of the contracted plan until the end of the period already paid. To avoid future charges, cancellation must be requested at least 10 days before the next renewal.
terms.cancellation_desc_2: The company reserves the right to cancel the subscription of paid plans if it does not receive payment within 10 days after the subscription due date. If this happens, the organization will be automatically moved to the Free Plan with limited access to the features available at the time of cancellation. Created files and projects will not be deleted, except in cases provided for in other clauses of the Terms of Use or Privacy and Personal Data Protection Policies. However, if the organization has exceeded the Free Plan limits, files will be blocked. Some previously configured features and automations may stop working if they are not available in the Free Plan.
terms.cancellation_desc_3: By adhering to a paid plan, the user agrees to the refund policy, which allows for a full refund within 07 (seven) days after payment for the first purchase of a paid plan. There will be no refunds after 07 (seven) days from the plan payment date.
terms.inactivation: Rules for deactivation and deletion of accounts
terms.inactivation_desc: To ensure data security and enable the free plan, organization accounts without an active Paid Plan will be permanently deleted if there is no access to the platform for 90 consecutive days. All data, projects, customers and files stored will be deleted. Only companies with an active subscription to a paid plan are exempt from this measure. The organization can request the deletion of an account and its data at any time, but this action cannot be performed by the Cange support team for security reasons.
terms.limitations: Rules adopted when exceeding plan limitations
terms.limitations_desc_1: Upon exceeding contracted file storage space, in any of the plans, it will no longer be possible to include new internal files by users, and, if new files are inserted through external forms, exceeding the contracted total by more than 5 (five)%, all files will be unavailable until the plan is regularized, by deleting less important files or by purchasing a larger data storage package.
terms.limitations_desc_2: If an organization that had contracted a plan stops paying for renewal, cancels its plan or downgrades, the rules of the free plan or the new contracted plan will apply for this organization immediately after the end of the contracted plan's period. If you have more files than the plan limit, your files will be blocked until payment is regularized or excess files are deleted.
terms.liability_desc_1: The Cange tool is a channel to facilitate the planning and management of processes, projects, tasks, teams and clients aiming to improve the organization and productivity of your company. We are not responsible for lost profits in case of technical or operational failures in the system.
terms.liability_desc_2: We will do everything in our power to provide a safe, stable and practical platform and maximize results for Platinum customers, but like any and all systems there may be technical or human failures and we are subject to them.
terms.liability_desc_3: When permitted by law, Cange and its service partners, licensors, employees, agents will not be liable for lost profits, revenues, or data, financial losses or indirect, special, consequential, exemplary, or punitive damages under any circumstance.
terms.liability_desc_4: The service is provided “as is”. This means that, although there is the intention to provide constant improvements and develop new features, we cannot guarantee the technical and commercial viability of the features we intend to develop, therefore some of them may be delayed or cancelled.
terms.liability_desc_5: Cange does not guarantee that: The service will meet all your requirements at all times; The service will be error-free; The service will not be interrupted.
terms.liability_desc_6: All content downloaded, uploaded and/or otherwise obtained through the use of the service is done at your own risk and you are solely responsible for any damage caused to your computer or devices, including but not limited to notebook, desktop, tablets, smartphones and smartwatches, or any loss of data resulting from the download or use of any materials mentioned above.
terms.liability_desc_7: It will not be possible to recover data, information and files deleted from the tool by a user of your organization. Cange confirms deletions through confirmation screens, and provides tools that favor good practice, such as privacy restrictions for cards, flows and files, and user profiles. Therefore, we understand that responsibility for users' full capacity of understanding lies with your Organization.
terms.prohibited_desc: The use of this tool for purposes that promote the following activities in any way is not allowed and will not be tolerated:
terms.prohibited_item_10: Attacks on individuals, groups or organizations
terms.prohibited_item_13: Any illegal content or content that promotes illegal activities or infringes legal rights.
terms.prohibited_summary: Cange, at its sole discretion, will determine what is abuse and/or misuse of our services.
terms.sanctions_desc: Cange has the right to block or permanently delete any user or organization that acts or encourages actions that violate the Terms of Use or that uses the Cange system in bad faith, such as corruption, defamation, violation of laws or rights, or any other activity which we consider inappropriate.
terms.terms_changes_desc: We have the right to modify these Terms of Use whenever necessary, whether due to updates to our services or the website, or because we recognize the need for update. If there are changes, we will inform you directly at your registered email. If you do not agree with the changes, you can request account deletion.
terms.corporate_changes_desc: If Cange participates in a negotiation, merger or total or partial sale, your personal data may be transferred to the new company that will become responsible for the security of such data. You will be informed about this change, if it happens.
terms.questions_desc: If you have any questions or need further clarification about our Terms of Use, please contact us at oi@cange.me and we will respond as soon as possible.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro_1: Our commitment is to protect your privacy and your personal data, so that you feel secure when using our platform and enjoy all its features. In this Privacy and Data Protection Policy, we describe what information we collect, how we store and process it, in addition to explaining the use of cookies and other similar technologies to improve your experience on the platform.
privacy.intro_2: We also address the commitment to data protection of customers, employees and other people registered on our platform. Whenever there are changes to the policy, we will inform you directly at your registered email address. If you do not accept our terms, it will not be possible to continue using Cange, but you can revoke your consent at any time.
privacy.intro_3: This Privacy and Personal Data Protection Policy is in compliance with the Brazilian General Data Protection Law (LGPD). By agreeing to our terms, you and your company undertake to strictly comply with the legislation and take responsibility for any consequences in case of non-compliance.
privacy.collection_desc_1: To make browsing our platform easier and more efficient, we collect two types of information: form information that you voluntarily provide when filling out a form and information collected automatically. Form information is collected when you register on the platform and may include additional information you choose to provide. Providing this information can improve the security and reliability of the platform and, for this reason, we may require some information to be mandatory. If you choose to use our paid services, we may also request payment information, which is stored securely for your convenience.
privacy.collection_desc_2: In addition, you can choose to fill out evaluation forms or participate in anonymous opinion surveys to help improve our services and provide valuable information to the market. We collect some information automatically, such as your IP address and cookie data, to understand how you use our platform and personalize your experience. We use cookies also for analytical and marketing purposes, but you can choose not to accept them in your browser.
privacy.collection_desc_3: When you provide contact information, such as phone or email, we use this information to improve our customer service and confirm your requests. We may monitor whether you open emails or click on links to personalize our marketing campaigns and improve your understanding of the platform.
privacy.collection_desc_4: All information we collect is kept in a secure and confidential database and deleted when no longer needed. It is important that you provide accurate and up-to-date information when registering, as we are not responsible for false or outdated information. We reserve the right to maintain information in our database to resolve legal disputes or complaints.
privacy.usage_title: How do we use the information collected?
privacy.usage_desc_1: There are several reasons why we collect information from users of the Cange platform. This information is used to improve service quality, increase safety for users, contact them, improve customer service, process financial transactions, personalize the user experience, and perform marketing activities. We also use this information to request reviews and feedback from users and collaborate with local authorities in legal investigations, whenever necessary.
privacy.usage_desc_2: We have good reasons for collecting information. This information can be used for the following purposes:
privacy.usage_item_1: Improving service quality. We use the data collected to identify the need for new tools and features in the system, identify possible flaws that need to be corrected, and improve Cange's usability and performance. We want the Platform to be increasingly pleasant, agile, useful and functional and we process the collected data to identify where we can improve;
privacy.usage_item_2: More security for you. Through the data collected we will be able to increasingly improve the Platform's security, identify, track and prevent fraud and inappropriate activities, mediate conflicts and collaborate with legal demands. In this regard, we reserve the right to block the use of suspicious users without prior notice and without liability for damages caused by this act, considering that the intention is to provide a secure and fraud-free environment for all users;
privacy.usage_item_3: Contact you. We use your personal contact data to send notifications and enable quick and direct contact whenever necessary. We will send answers to your questions and request evaluations of the Platform;
privacy.usage_item_4: Improve customer service. Our customer service will be able to access your data when and only if you request it, with the aim of improving the efficiency and agility of the service. The only way our service team can access your organization's environment is through the support user, at your request, for a period of one hour and in a visible and identifiable way by you;
privacy.usage_item_5: Process financial transactions. If you use any of Cange's paid services, we will use your data to process financial transactions and carry out payments, if you so desire and authorize. Our team does not have access to payment data, they are saved directly by the payment method, with all the necessary security;
privacy.usage_item_6: Personalize the experience. Not all users have the same needs and expectations when using Cange. For this reason, when we collect your data, we do our best to personalize your experience on Cange, making it increasingly pleasant and useful for you. We intend to send tips and content that are relevant and useful to you;
privacy.usage_item_7: Marketing Activities. We intend to use the data provided to create personalized offers in Cange. You can edit your preferences for receiving these offers and other types of communications in your personal data area;
privacy.usage_item_8: Service evaluations. We will request evaluations and feedback on our services so that we can always improve;
privacy.usage_item_9: Legal Purposes. We will use the data collected, whenever requested and possible to meet, to collaborate with local authorities in legal investigations.
privacy.sharing_title: Do we share any information with third parties?
privacy.sharing_desc: We guarantee that your private and identifiable information is not sold or transferred to third parties, except for essential partners who are necessary for the Platform's operation. However, our contracts with these partners include security and confidentiality clauses to protect your information. If necessary to comply with laws and judicial orders, collaborate with legal investigations or protect our rights, property or security, we may transfer information to local authorities. If requested by government authorities, we will not hesitate to collaborate with them.
privacy.security_desc: Cange is committed to protecting your data with the best security technologies available and adopts procedures to restrict access to the data provided. Only authorized people can access this data to perform specific tasks. If any data leak occurs, Cange will notify the competent authority and inform affected users so they can take appropriate measures. It is recommended that users periodically check their data and do not share passwords or record them in any media or browser. The company must also have well-defined permission and access controls to ensure data and information protection.
privacy.content_title: The content produced by you or your organization on our service
privacy.content_desc: By using the Cange platform, you are allowed to upload, download and store various types of content, including information, images, videos, audio and any other material, for which you hold the intellectual rights. However, by sending or receiving content through the platform, you grant Cange and its business partners a worldwide license to store, send and download content for the sole purpose of providing the service to you, your organization and others with whom you share the content. We reserve the right to remove or refuse the distribution of any content through the platform, including yours. In case of police investigations or other official actions to combat fraud or crimes, we will collaborate with the authorities, providing the data stored in our databases if formally requested.
privacy.third_party_desc: When using our platform, you may be directed to third-party sites using sponsored or non-sponsored links. We will not share your data with these sites without your permission. However, it is important to remember that when browsing these sites, you will be subject to their privacy policies, which may be different from ours. We are not responsible for the content or privacy of these sites. If you notice any suspicious or misleading activity on a site linked to our platform, we ask that you let us know so we can take appropriate action.
privacy.obligations_desc: The user is responsible for maintaining the security of their login information, periodically updating their passwords and using safe passwords. In addition, they must comply with Cange's Terms of Use, Privacy Policy and Data Protection and respect the intellectual property rights of third parties. The user must not provide sensitive information or disseminate offensive or illegal content. Cange reserves the right to ban any user who violates these policies. The user declares that all information provided is true and that they have authorization to disclose it. Providing false information can result in civil and criminal liability.
privacy.sensitive_data_desc: LGPD establishes that certain personal data are sensitive, such as information about race, ethnicity, religion, political opinion, union affiliation or religious organization, health, genetic or biometric data linked to a natural person. Cange does not request or monitor this type of information in relation to its customers. If your organization needs to collect and handle sensitive personal data, you must do so in accordance with LGPD, collecting only the minimum necessary and with a clear and legal purpose, informing the customer of the purpose and way of processing such data. The organization's owner is responsible for ensuring compliance with LGPD requirements, avoiding possible internal and external data leaks, using data protection resources and maintaining the security of users' personal passwords.
privacy.children_data_title: Personal data of Children and Adolescents
privacy.children_data_desc: LGPD requires that children and adolescents' data be treated with maximum care. Cange does not request or process personal data of minors in its services, and does not allow the use of the platform by children and adolescents without prior authorization from parents or guardians. If it is necessary to collect and process data from minors, this must be done in full compliance with LGPD, collecting only the minimum necessary data and clearly informing the customer about the purpose and processing of such data. The organization's owner is responsible for ensuring compliance with LGPD requirements, protecting data from leaks and using all safety measures available, such as the appropriate use of user profiles and display restrictions. Cange does not support child labor, except in cases provided for by law.
privacy.access_info_desc: Cange allows you to access and correct your personal data at any time, except for usage history data. To access your data, simply go to the "Profile" menu. The company does not collect more personal data than necessary and considers your email address as the only true information. It is recommended to keep your password secure and updated to protect your data and your organization's data. If you need to anonymize your identifiable data, send an email to oi@cange.me from the registered email address, but complete deletion of the organization can only be done by a user with an owner profile. Deletion cannot be performed through the Cange support team for safety reasons.
privacy.privacy_changes_title: Changes to Cange's Privacy Policy and Data Protection
privacy.privacy_changes_desc: We reserve the right to update this Privacy Policy whenever there is a change to the platform, associated sites, services and business model or if we deem it necessary. If there are changes, we will inform you so that you can know the updates and agree or not to the new terms. If you agree, you can continue using Cange and its benefits, but if you do not agree, you will no longer be able to use them.
privacy.corporate_changes_desc: If Cange participates in a negotiation, merger or total or partial sale, your personal data may be transferred to the new company that will become responsible for the security of such data. You will be informed about this change, if it happens.
privacy.questions_desc: If there are any questions or need for further clarification about our Privacy Policy and Personal Data Protection, please contact us at oi@cange.me and we will respond as soon as possible.
